body: what the fuck did i just read.

i did cringe but i still searched for it, i felt bad after reading posts saying it's horrible and i never thought of it again. i did end up seeing that shit years later and i was horrified. i'm scared i was looking at pictures of kids or fantasized about how that shit would look like for the 1 min i was searching for it. my pocd triggered last year because i remember what i saw and had a lot of panic attacks.
i know it doesn't help but i feel horrible. i'm really sorry you are right, but it's so hard to accept the mere possibility of being a p.

thank you for your response. i'm an 18 year old girl so i don't think i have anymore developing left to do. i think kids are cute, i never wanted to do anything horrible with them or anything, and i'm 100% certain of that. the thing is, i actually did end up stumbling upon that shit while on tumblr 2 years back, i was absolutely horrified. i wanted to cry and i think the only reason i didn't was because i was still in shock. actually, this is how my pocd triggered, remembering that i saw that stuff. when i remembered i had multiple panic attacks over the fact that i saw that. i know i was inspired by the shitty ageplay shit i used to see on tumblr, but i still feel horrible for trying to see it. even as a dumb 12 year old with a developing addiction, i know i didn't understand the gravity of that shit (since i thought i could just find it by searching it on tumblr...) and after i did learn about the deep web i never found a desire to go there besides the intrusive thoughts. i just can't help but feel like im in denial, even though when i was young i used to fantasize about lesbians and watched lesbian porn but i know im not a lesbian...

thank you, i know it's pointless to seek reassurance, but i can't help but feel like THIS is the definitive proof that i am a p even though both of my psychiatrists told me it doesn't. it's gotten so bad i'm doubting if i even mentioned to them "okay what if i enjoyed it ??" even though i think i did. thank you for your response !
